contexts.text: Today = what is perpetual. Illustrated.
To this day = for ever.
When anything was hidden under an oak, it signified what is perpetual. Explained.

Perpetual rejection. Signified.
All the days = for ever.
Tomorrow = for ever.
That it shall be perpetually in the will. Signified, Explained.
That it shall be perpetually in the understanding. Signified, Explained.
From generation to generation = perpetually.
In all time = for ever.
Good and truth with them for ever. Signified.
What is perpetual in the thought. Signified, Explained.
He shall serve him for ever () = to eternity. Explained.
For ever without a change. Signified, Explained.
Subsistence is perpetual existence, and conservation is perpetual creation. DP 3:2. TCR 46:end.
Perpetuity without change, is represented by the non-removal of the staves from the ark.
The conservation of good and truth on all sides and for ever. Signified, Explained.
Once in a year = perpetually. Explained.
The perpetual removal of evils. Signified, Explained.
This Divine influx is perpetual.
In every Divine work there is a union of love and wisdom; from which is its perpetuity; nay, its eternity.
The infinite in the conjunction; the eternal in the perpetuity.
There is a perpetual correspondence... TCR 583.
